          about

          Four classic tracks remixed in the way only The Gaslight Troubadours can.

          Also now available on CD and Vinyl with the original Salambo album from: elasticstage.com/marcalmond/releases/salambo-album
          both formats limited to 500 copies.

          credits

          released October 31, 2026

          Threat Of Love with Siouxsie Sioux (Gaslight Troubadours Remix) (Almond/Whitmore)
          Mother Fist (Gaslight Troubadours Remix) (Almond)
          Black Heart (Gaslight Troubadours Remix) (Almond/Hogan/Johnson)
          Torment (Gaslight Troubadours Remix) (Almond/Severin/Smith)

          All tracks remixed and reworked by The Gaslight Troubadours

          Original production on Threat Of Love: Kenny Jones and Marc Almond
          Original production on Mother Fist: Mike Hedges
          Original production on Black Heart: Flood and Marc Almond
          Original production on Torment: Flood and Marc Almond
          Guitars and extra vocals on Torment: Lee Jenkinson
          Percussion on Threat of Love: Budgie

          Cover by Etienne Gilfillan
